title: pteris aquilina var. esculenta
intro: Pteris aquilina var. esculenta, commonly known as Bracken, is a type of fern that belongs to the Pteridaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to stimulate digestion and relieve inflammation, making it a popular remedy for various health issues. The health benefits of Pteris aquilina var. esculenta include its potential to reduce blood pressure, improve liver function, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic compounds, that contribute to its anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antimicrobial properties.
